review_scope: complete latest repository disk copy, byte-for-byte, line-by-line, untruncated

findings.summary: The first reviewer-receipt design bound only changed blobs, which did not machine-bind the claimed complete latest repository review. The gate now binds every tracked path, mode, and blob except the self-referential receipt.

Kernel default area and node parameters were encoded through masking before validation, and an overlong default node name could be truncated. Defaults are now validated before address construction and copying.
The staged project-state gate validated working-tree text rather than the exact staged bytes, allowing a different unstaged copy to hide a bad staged continuity record.
The commit-message hook was stored without executable mode, so the repository-policy commit-message check was not reliably invoked by Git.

External baseline CI bypassed the project-owned Route20 and PyDECnet forks and fetched upstream repositories directly. CI and reference documentation now use the pinned project forks, with upstreams reserved for comparison.
The root README documented an image/alpine directory that does not yet exist. It now marks the image-builder directory as a Phase 2 deliverable instead of presenting it as current repository state.

The project-state range gate assumed event base and head revisions already existed in the checkout. A rewritten working branch exposed that missing event revisions can be absent; the gate now fetches missing revisions before range validation.

The project contract names HANDOVER as an authoritative continuity artifact, but no HANDOVER file existed. A stable docs/HANDOVER.md entry point now directs fresh sessions to PROJECT_STATE, ROADMAP, and the reviewer procedure.
After adding HANDOVER, the root README still told resuming sessions to start with PROJECT_STATE, contradicting the new stable entry point. README now consistently directs resumption through HANDOVER.

The live PROJECT_STATE resume text would become stale immediately after promoting the reviewed commit to main. Resume and next-action text are now correct both before promotion and after the exact commit reaches main.
